# AiPRIL (iced-latte.com)

> personal website and working notebook of april (hanh le), a marketer and operator moving deeper into marketing systems, product growth, measurement, and ai workflows.

## core pages
- [homepage & profile](https://iced-latte.com/): overview of april's background, marketing craft, tiny ai builds, and contact details.
- [rss feed](https://iced-latte.com/rss.xml): xml feed of published essays and working notes.
- [sitemap](https://iced-latte.com/sitemap.xml): canonical url index.

## writing & working notes
- [the 90-9-1 rule: moving from consuming to building](https://iced-latte.com/writing/90-9-1-from-consuming-to-building/): why i decided to stop just consuming content on the internet and start building tiny projects of my own with ai. (markdown: https://iced-latte.com/posts/90-9-1-from-consuming-to-building.md)
- [why i’m moving from marketing craft into marketing systems](https://iced-latte.com/writing/craft-meets-marketing-systems/): plenty of people can pull a number. fewer can say what marketing should do because of it. (markdown: https://iced-latte.com/posts/craft-meets-marketing-systems.md)

## lab projects
- [marketing systems lab](https://github.com/hanh-le-hong/marketing-systems-lab): public repository practising measurement, kpi trees, ai fluency, and marketing automation.
- [snapcard](https://snapcard-dc0ca.web.app/): lightweight web app for creating and sending digital postcards with a single link.
